why: Three ADRs and AGENTS.md:209 name this file as the admission control for warm cache reads. It did not exist: deleted by a20b2c808, leaving a documented kill-switch that nothing implemented and nothing enforced. A declared control that is absent is worse than no control, because every reader believes they are covered by it. Restored so the documentation and the tree agree.
how_to_license: Set warm_reads_licensed to true and record the canary run id that justified it in licensed_by_canary_run. That is a founder decision, one line, review-visible. Until then every consumer reads false and skips the cache, which is the dark-by-default state ADR-0716 D2 describes.
